title: Browser test workflow data
description: Inline test values and seeded fake-data records that step values reference as {{data.path}}.

fields.label: Inline values (path=value, optional)
fields.help: One per line, for example user.password=correct horse. Steps use them as {{data.user.password}}.

fields.label: Fake-data records (alias=config:<id>#<index>, optional)
fields.help: One per line: customer=config:contacts-demo#0 reuses a saved generation config; person=entity:contact@7#2 uses an entity, a seed and a record index. Steps use them as {{data.customer.email}}.
